about: One-time type restore. Each entry is a video a Full Recheck wrongly switched to "stream" after it went private/deleted/unlisted; "to" is the type saved while it was public, from the repo history. update.js applies an entry only while the video still has the "from" type, so this is safe to leave in place and can be deleted once applied.
